The BRF uses six-dot Braille, at most 40 cells per line and 25 lines per page, with form-feed page breaks. It contains 866 pages because the original includes its full code and archive. Match your embosser's paper and layout settings to this file.

The source address and SHA-256 are transcribed into the file's Braille preface. Long technical strings use a dot-5 continuation sign. Characters outside the table's coverage are identified with explicit Unicode code-point descriptions; none are silently dropped.

This is English uncontracted UEB, not a translation into other languages or a tactile drawing of the mirror. Braille proofreading and a physical embossing test have not been performed. Exact source punctuation and formatting remain available in the source text and original HTML downloads.
